description: This file declares functions and types related to parsing and handling line range specifications, including range argument parsing, callbacks for line number retrieval, and filename parsing within a version control context.

methods.name: parse_range_arg
methods.description: Parse a line range argument, determine the start and end lines within a file, and handle error cases.

methods.name: skip_range_arg
methods.description: Advance beyond a range argument in a string to identify the filename portion, if present.
